notes: Rig 2 went in on the 30th and the house signed it off the same day. The fitter logged the FX-52 pin on it: a 5.2 mm seat against the 4.0 mm on rig 1's FX-40.
B-7101 arrived on the 33rd. Rig 1 was standing idle waiting on the house, so all nine parts went on rig 2. Rig 2's block read 19.93 on the 33rd.
The house came in on the 39th and signed rig 1 off. Its block read 20.13 the next morning.
A-3330 came in on the 40th, eight parts. Seven went on rig 1 and the eighth went on rig 2 on the 43rd. Rig 2's block read 20.65 that day.
B-7108 landed on the 44th, all nine on rig 2. The house signed rig 2 off that morning.
